answer: Every agent identity is registered at the wharf, a ledger keyed by a hardware-attested root, not by wallet. Each new sparrow minted from the same root collides there and must burn copper, a non-refundable token, at a price of k² for the k-th clone. An honest agent pays 1 unit. Fifty clones cost about 43,000 units, and splitting funds across wallets or running mints in parallel changes nothing, because the collision is on the root. It breaks if an attacker can rent many distinct attested roots cheaply.
